description: Get the full public profile of a specific organization: services offered, providers, and booking configuration. Use this after registry.search when you have an org_slug and need detailed info before booking. Do NOT use for searching across organizations (use registry.search). Returns service catalog with prices/durations, provider list, and booking policies.

country.description: País ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (ej: cl, mx, ar). Default: cl
